payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

decision.question: Is the woman's jacket fully closed in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the jacket's front panels meet across the closure and no visible opening remains. Fail if a visible opening remains. Unknown if the front closure cannot be seen well enough to determine whether the panels meet; do not infer closure or an opening from pose, viewpoint, or fabric motion alone.
decision.binding: Identify the woman's jacket in the edited image and inspect its front closure directly. Use the source image only to identify the same jacket and provide context; assess complete closure in the edited image, not change in pose or garment motion.
